draft-a.name: Alex Chen
draft-a.summary: Software engineer building reliable cloud services and operational tools in C#, Go and Python. Experience spans authentication, message queues, Kubernetes delivery and telemetry-driven diagnostics, including technical leadership of a five-person data-center engineering team.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Developed PulseBus, a message queue backend carrying authentication events, and automated restart-based recovery of blocked queues; 90% of supported-scope incidents were mitigated within 30 minutes of detection, with unresolved cases escalated to engineers.

Built C#/ASP.NET Core authentication services for a platform supporting two million enterprise tenants, with token validation, tenant isolation and endpoint authorization. Operated stateless Docker services on AKS across Availability Zones using health checks, canaries and rollback; overall authentication-service SLA: 99.99%.
Integrated Kusto/KQL telemetry, logs and Copilot diagnostics, reducing fault-localization time by 80%; participated in on-call and production readiness reviews.

Technically led a five-person team building data-center cooling telemetry, risk triggers and diagnostic workflows in C#/.NET. GPU-throttling incident frequency decreased approximately 10% versus the historical baseline; engineers retained remediation decisions.

Built a Python/RAG authentication-support assistant, reducing manual handling time by 85%; owned ingestion, retrieval, evaluation and deployment. Used Copilot and Claude Code for tests, refactoring and security fixes, with human review and CI validation.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Developed Go services integrating Kafka events, MySQL and Redis; deployed Docker/Kubernetes services across two clouds with canary and rolling releases.
